description: An expander for Tyrant, placed immediately to its right, which turns Tyrant's probability decisions into polyphonic triggers

outputs.text: A trigger on each channel whose incoming clock pulse was skipped
A trigger on each channel whose stored voltages were reordered
A trigger on each channel that received the Accent A offset
A trigger on each channel that received the Accent B offset
A trigger on each channel that received the random accent
A trigger on every channel when Tyrant is reset

notes: the outputs stay silent unless a Tyrant is the module immediately to the left and touching it
